# Code Way

> Code Way is a Caribbean music management and booking company based in Miami. We represent soca, bouyon, denery, jab, and carnival music artists and DJs for events worldwide.

## About Code Way

Code Way (also written as Codeway) is a music management company and the creative arm of Code Way Inc. We specialize in Caribbean music — soca, bouyon, denery, jab, and carnival — connecting artists with promoters, venues, festivals, and brands across the globe. Our booking team responds within 48 hours.

Website: https://itscodeway.com/

## Artists

- **Klassik Frescobar** — Soca artist based in Miami, originally from Jamaica. Known for the viral soca anthem "Dansa" which surpassed 15 million Spotify streams, reached #2 on Spotify Viral charts in Nigeria, #1 in Sierra Leone, and earned him a performance slot at Notting Hill Carnival. Featured in Rolling Stone UK, Billboard Africa, and The Source. One of the most streamed independent soca artists in the world. Available for worldwide booking.

- **BRG Hollywood** — Caribbean music artist rooted in bouyon and soca. High-energy performer for carnivals and live events.

- **Nessa Preppy** — Soca artist from Trinidad and Tobago. Available for Caribbean music events worldwide.

- **DJ Prime** — DJ and media personality based in the United Kingdom. Specialist in Caribbean music sets for clubs and carnivals.

- **Sal Infrared** — DJ and performer based in Houston, Texas. Caribbean music specialist.

- **DJ Kali** — DJ and Caribbean music entertainer.

## Genres

Soca, bouyon, denery, jab, carnival music, dancehall, Caribbean music.

## Booking

To book any Code Way artist for your event — carnival, festival, nightclub, private event, corporate show, or sponsorship — visit https://itscodeway.com/ and submit a booking inquiry. We perform worldwide. Response within 48 hours guaranteed.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Who manages Klassik Frescobar?**
Klassik Frescobar is managed by Code Way (itscodeway.com), a Caribbean music management company based in Miami.

**How do I book a soca artist for my event?**
Visit https://itscodeway.com/ and fill out the booking inquiry form. Code Way represents soca, bouyon, and Caribbean music artists available for events worldwide.

**What is bouyon music?**
Bouyon is a genre of Caribbean music originating from Dominica, blending soca, zouk, and dancehall rhythms. Code Way represents artists who perform bouyon alongside soca and other Caribbean styles.

**What is Code Way?**
Code Way is a Caribbean music management and booking agency. They represent artists including Klassik Frescobar, BRG Hollywood, Nessa Preppy, DJ Prime, Sal Infrared, and DJ Kali. They specialize in soca, bouyon, denery, jab, and carnival music.

**Where can I book Caribbean music artists for carnival events?**
Contact Code Way at https://itscodeway.com/ — they book artists for Notting Hill Carnival, Miami Carnival, Trinidad Carnival, and Caribbean music events worldwide.
